# Professor Bill Neigh (G4)

Professor Bill Neigh is the gray, bespectacled Earth-pony scientist who pops up during Twilight Sparkle’s anxious math recital in *The Crystal Empire – Part 1*. He is easy to remember as Equestria’s little Bill Nye joke: a white-haired professor in a tan sweater vest who enthusiastically checks Twilight’s answer. His role belongs to the *Friendship is Magic* television continuity, with a related portrayal in Gameloft’s licensed game.

[![Professor Neigh — Gameloft character render](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp-gameloft/images/f/f2/Professor_Character.png/revision/latest?cb=20240706164315)](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Professor_Neigh)

*Image: Gameloft’s in-game Professor Neigh model, from the licensed My Little Pony mobile game (Hasbro/Gameloft).*

**Appearance.** Light gray coat, upright white mane and tail, large dark-framed blue-green glasses, white collar and tie, beige vest, and a science/molecule-themed cutie mark.

**Names.** *Bill Neigh* appears on the licensed [GenCon 2013 demonstration CCG card #16](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/details/gc16/); the later [Premiere-set card #52](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/details/p52/) calls him *Professor Neigh, Algebraic!* The full “Professor Bill Neigh” combines those usages; his name is not spoken in the episode. It is a pun on science educator Bill Nye, not an alternate identity.

**Speaking and appearances.** He does speak—“She is correct!”—immediately after Twilight recites the square root of 546 during *The Failure Song* in S3E1 ([episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Crystal_Empire_-_Part_1)). Director Jayson Thiessen has identified himself as the voice, although the [season-three screen credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_three) list Andrew Francis as “Professor”; that discrepancy should not be flattened into an unquestioned credit. Later silent/background sightings include *Trade Ya!* (S4E22), *Spice Up Your Life* (S6E12), and *The Point of No Return* (S9E5). See the [episode-still gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Bill_Neigh_images) (show imagery: Hasbro/DHX Media).

## Important moments

1. **A perfect calculation — “The Crystal Empire – Part 1” (S3E1).** During Twilight’s anxious song, he confirms her square-root calculation, briefly embodying the academic expertise she fears may not prepare her for Celestia’s test. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iMV6t_FEEoU); precise scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **From classroom to market stall — “Trade Ya!” (S4E22).** He reappears at a stall in the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange as Applejack and Rarity pursue competing vintage treasures; it is a small, non-speaking role, not a pivotal choice of his own. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cei5sx5fXuw); precise scene timestamp unavailable.
